name: smwpatches-rexes-with-extra-bit-set-are-squished
title: Rexes With Extra Bit Set Are Squished
description:
This patch makes rexes with extra bit set (Edit > Insert manual in sprite editing mode, Sprite command AB, Extra bits 1) to spawn squished.

You can change the way the patch is implemented by changing the defines in the asm file.

You need to run PIXI on your rom at least once for this patch to work properly.
